{{Quote|Caamasi and Alderaanian peace officers, led by Jedi Master Rancisis, arrived at the Trandoshan city of Hsskhor to meet with Kashyyyk Senator Yarua and Trandoshan Speaker-Above-All Hadocrassk.|Extract from the HoloNet News Vol. 531 48|<ref name="HNN48" />}}
There were '''peace negociations''' that took place at [[Hsskhor/Legends|Hsskhor]], capital of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandosha]], between representatives of the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] and the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] from the neighboring [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] in an effort to end their ancestral conflict. The conference failed after the Trandoshans went behind the Wookiees' back and requested the help of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] to earn a seat on the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. Despite the mediating efforts of the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Oppo Rancisis/Legends|Oppo Rancisis]], the Wookiee senator [[Yarua/Legends|Yarua]] refused to continue the discussions, and withdrew his delegation from the peace talks.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|A long-standing blood-feud between the Wookiees and the Trandoshans have brought their neighboring worlds to the brink of war.|Extract from the HoloNet News Vol. 531 48|<ref name="HNN48" />}}
The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] and the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] of [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandosha]] were two [[Species/Legends|species]] that hailed from [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|the same]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]], in the [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Around the time of the [[Jedi Civil War]] in [[3959 BBY]], the Trandoshans negotiated with the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]] corporation to gain [[Slavery/Legends|slaving]] rights to their Wookiee neighbors, which started a millennia-long blood-feud between the two species.<ref name="KOTORCG">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> Thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, on the third [[Standard month/Legends|month]] of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Kashyyyk and Trandosha came at the threshold of a war after a Wookiee [[Transport/Legends|transport]] was attacked over one of Trandosha's [[Moon/Legends|moons]]. In addition to those tensions, the Trandoshans petitioned for representation within the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. While Wookiees delegates traditionally represented the whole Kashyyyk system in the Senate, the Trandoshans maintained it had been to their detriment. It was decided that a series of meetings would be organized to to help foster smoother relations.<ref name="HNN48" />

==The meetings==
{{Quote|These meetings are meaningless if such actions can go on outside this conference.|Senator Yarua|<ref name="HNN50" />}}
The Kashyyyk&ndash;Trandosha peace negotiations were set to take place at [[Tally-house Meeting Halls]] of [[Hsskhor/Legends|Hsskhor]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of Trandosha. The Wookiees were represented by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Yarua/Legends|Yarua]], and the Trandoshans by [[Speaker-Above-All]] [[Hadocrassk]]. The Galactic Republic also sent a mediation delegation composed [[Caamasi/Legends|Caamasi]] and [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]] and headed by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Oppo Rancisis/Legends|Oppo Rancisis]]. Despite that, the talks started shakily, and continued in the same vein for some time.<ref name="HNN48" /> However, two [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] later, an appeal to the Senate was scheduled by [[Crovessk]], the CEO of Trandosha's [[Revessa Global Shipping]], through contacts with [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]], who represented the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] conglomerate. When Yarua learned that he had been double-crossed, he got incensed. He stormed out of the negotiations, which he described as "meaningless," after destroying the [[Translator droid/Legends|interpreter droid]] that translated the talks. Despite their best efforts, Oppo Rancisis and his peace officers failed to persuade the Wookiees against leaving.<ref name="HNN50" />
